# fish completion for homepodctl
function _homepodctl_scan
    set -l context root
    set -l pending ''
    set -l optional 0
    set -l ended 0
    set -l position 0
    set -l offset 0
    set -l current $argv[-1]
    set -e argv[-1]
    set -l boolean_words '0' '1' 'false' 'n' 'no' 'off' 'on' 'true' 'y' 'yes'
    set -l options
    set -l value_flags
    set -l position_flags
    set -l boolean_flags
    set -l terminal
    set -l children
    set -l positional
    set -l start
    set -l repeat
    set -l stop
    set -l legacy
    set -l literal
    while true
        set options
        set value_flags
        set position_flags
        set boolean_flags
        set terminal
        set children
        set positional ''
        set start 0
        set repeat 0
        set stop 0
        set legacy 0
        set literal 0
        switch $context
        case 'aliases'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'automation'
            set options
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal
            set children 'init' 'plan' 'run' 'validate'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'automation init'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--name' '--preset' '-h'
            set value_flags '--name' '--preset'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'automation plan'
            set options '--file' '--help' '--json' '-f' '-h'
            set value_flags '-f' '--file'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'automation run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--file' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '-f' '-h'
            set value_flags '-f' '--file'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'automation validate'
            set options '--file' '--help' '--json' '-f' '-h'
            set value_flags '-f' '--file'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'completion'
            set options '--help' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children 'install'
            set positional 'shells'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'completion install'
            set options '--help' '--path' '-h'
            set value_flags '--path'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'shells'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'config'
            set options
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal
            set children 'get' 'set' 'validate'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'config get'
            set options '--help' '--json' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'config set'
            set options '--help' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 1
        case 'config validate'
            set options '--help' '--json' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'config-init'
            set options '--help' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'devices'
            set options '--help' '--include-network' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--include-network' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'doctor'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'help'
            set options '--help' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'commands'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 1
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'native-run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--shortcut' '-h'
            set value_flags '--shortcut'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'next'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'now'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--watch' '-h'
            set value_flags '--watch'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'out'
            set options
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal
            set children 'list' 'set'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'out list'
            set options '--help' '--include-network' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--include-network' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'out set'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '-h'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 0
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'pause'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan'
            set options '--json'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal
            set children 'automation' 'native-run' 'out' 'play' 'run' 'vol' 'volume'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'plan automation'
            set options '--json'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal
            set children 'run'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan automation run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--file' '--json' '--no-input' '-f'
            set value_flags '-f' '--file'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan native-run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--json' '--shortcut'
            set value_flags '--shortcut'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'plan out'
            set options '--json'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal
            set children 'set'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan out set'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 0
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan play'
            set options '--backend' '--choose' '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--shuffle' '--volume'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--volume'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--choose' '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--shuffle'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional 'playlists'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional 'aliases'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan vol'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set position_flags '--value' '--volume'
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 1
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'plan volume'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set position_flags '--value' '--volume'
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 1
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'play'
            set options '--backend' '--choose' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--shuffle' '--volume' '-h'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--volume'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--choose' '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--shuffle'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'playlists'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'playlists'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--limit' '--plain' '--query' '-h'
            set value_flags '--limit' '--query'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 1
            set literal 0
        case 'prev'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'root'
            set options '--help' '--quiet' '--verbose' '--version' '-h' '-q' '-v'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '--version' '-h'
            set children 'aliases' 'automation' 'completion' 'config' 'config-init' 'devices' 'doctor' 'help' 'native-run' 'next' 'now' 'out' 'pause' 'plan' 'play' 'playlists' 'prev' 'run' 'schema' 'setup' 'status' 'stop' 'tui' 'version' 'vol' 'volume'
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'run'
            set options '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'aliases'
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'schema'
            set options '--help' '--json' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'setup'
            set options '--backend' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '--room' '-h'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--no-input'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'status'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--watch' '-h'
            set value_flags '--watch'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'stop'
            set options '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'tui'
            set options '--help' '--refresh' '-h'
            set value_flags '--refresh'
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'version'
            set options '--help' '-h'
            set value_flags
            set position_flags
            set boolean_flags
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional ''
            set start 0
            set repeat 0
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'vol'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume' '-h'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set position_flags '--value' '--volume'
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 1
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0
        case 'volume'
            set options '--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume' '-h'
            set value_flags '--backend' '--room' '--value' '--volume'
            set position_flags '--value' '--volume'
            set boolean_flags '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'
            set terminal '--help' '-h'
            set children
            set positional 'rooms'
            set start 1
            set repeat 1
            set stop 0
            set legacy 0
            set literal 0

        end
        if not set -q argv[1]
            break
        end
        set -l word $argv[1]
        set -e argv[1]
        if test -n "$pending"
            set pending ''
            continue
        end
        if test $optional = 1
            set optional 0
            if contains -- (string lower -- (string trim -- "$word")) $boolean_words
                continue
            end
        end
        if test $ended = 0
            if test "$word" = --
                test "$context" = root; and return
                if test "$context" != plan
                    set ended 1
                end
                continue
            end
            if string match -q -- '-*' "$word"; and test "$word" != -
                set -l parts (string split -m 1 = -- "$word")
                set -l flag $parts[1]
                set -l attached 0
                set -l value ''
                set -l flag_legacy $legacy
                if set -q parts[2]
                    set attached 1
                    set value $parts[2]
                end
                if string match -q 'plan*' "$context"; and test "$flag" = --json
                    set flag_legacy 1
                end
                if test $legacy = 1; and not string match -q -- '--*' "$flag"; and not contains -- "$flag" -h -f
                    set flag -$flag
                end
                if test "$flag" = -f; and test "$word" != -f
                    return
                end
                contains -- "$flag" $options; or return
                contains -- "$flag" $terminal; and return
                if contains -- "$flag" $value_flags
                    if contains -- "$flag" $position_flags
                        set offset 1
                    end
                    if test $attached = 0; or begin; test -z "$value"; and test $flag_legacy = 0; end
                        set pending $flag
                    end
                else if contains -- "$flag" $boolean_flags
                    if test $attached = 0; or begin; test -z "$value"; and test $flag_legacy = 0; end
                        set optional 1
                    end
                else if test $attached = 1
                    return
                end
                continue
            end
        end
        if test $position = 0; and contains -- "$word" $children
            if test "$context" = root
                set context $word
            else
                set context "$context $word"
            end
            continue
        end
        if test $literal = 1; or test $stop = 1
            return
        end
        if set -q children[1]; and test -z "$positional"
            return
        end
        set position (math $position + 1)
    end
    set -l group none
    if test -n "$pending"
        switch $pending
            case '--backend'
                set group 'backends'
            case '--playlist'
                set group 'playlists'
            case '--preset'
                set group 'presets'
            case '--room'
                set group 'rooms'

        end
    else if test $ended = 0; and string match -q -- '-*' "$current"
        if string match -q '*=*' -- "$current"
            set -l flag (string split -m 1 = -- "$current")[1]
            contains -- "$flag" $options; or return
            if contains -- "$flag" $value_flags; or contains -- "$flag" $boolean_flags
                set group inline:$flag
            end
        else
            set group options:$context
        end
    else if test $position = 0; and set -q children[1]
        set group children:$context
    else if test -n "$positional"; and test (math $position + $offset) -ge $start; and begin; test $repeat = 1; or test (math $position + $offset) = $start; end
        set group $positional
    else if test $ended = 0; and test -z "$current"
        set group options:$context
    end
    printf '%s\n' "$group"
end

function _homepodctl_wants
    set -l line (commandline -cp | string collect --allow-empty)
    # All registrations for one completion share the same pure argument walk.
    if not set -q _homepodctl_cache_line; or test "$_homepodctl_cache_line" != "$line"
        set -l raw_current (commandline -ct | string collect --allow-empty)
        set -l prefix_length (math (string length -- "$line") - (string length -- "$raw_current"))
        set -l prefix (string sub -l $prefix_length -- "$line" | string collect --allow-empty)
        set -l tokens
        set -l current_tokens
        # Tokenize without evaluating substitutions; NUL framing preserves
        # quoted newlines in completed values.
        printf '%s\0' "$prefix" | read -z -t -a tokens
        printf '%s\0' "$raw_current" | read -z -t -a current_tokens
        set -l current ''
        if set -q current_tokens[1]
            set current $current_tokens[1]
        end
        set -e tokens[1]
        set -g _homepodctl_cache_group (_homepodctl_scan $tokens "$current")
        set -g _homepodctl_cache_current "$current"
        set -g _homepodctl_cache_line "$line"
    end
    test "$_homepodctl_cache_group" = "$argv[1]"
end

function _homepodctl_candidates
    # Fish otherwise applies fuzzy matching, which can offer unrelated
    # spellings for a prefix such as --c. All shells use literal prefixes.
    set -l pattern '^'(string escape --style=regex -- "$_homepodctl_cache_current")
    for candidate in $argv
        set -l name (string split -m 1 \t -- "$candidate")[1]
        if string match -q -r -- "$pattern" "$name"
            printf '%s\0' "$candidate"
        end
    end
end

complete -c homepodctl -f
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'backends\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'airplay\' \'native\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'booleans\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'true\' \'false\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:automation\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'init\' \'plan	Preview command execution\' \'run	Run alias\' \'validate\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:completion\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'install\' \'bash\' \'zsh\' \'fish\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:config\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'get\' \'set\' \'validate\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:out\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'list\' \'set\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:plan\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'automation	Run automation routines\' \'native-run	Run shortcut\' \'out	Manage outputs\' \'play	Play playlist\' \'run	Run alias\' \'vol	Set volume\' \'volume	Set volume\' | string split0)'
complete -c homepodctl -n '_homepodctl_wants \'children:plan automation\'' -a '(_homepodctl_candidates \'run	Run alias\' | string split0)'
